name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited
summary: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited, an investment company, provides financial services in India. It operates through Financing, Insurance, and Others segments. The company offers vehicle finance, loans against property, home loans, secured business and personal loans, consumer and small enterprises loans, gold loans, and small and medium enterprise loans, as well as various other financial services to customers; and general insurance services, including motor, property and casualty, health, accident, fire and engineering, crop, marine, and travel insurance, as well as reinsurance.
